% A document with tocloft's \newlistof, beside the stale
% test-staleaux-toc-color.exp of an earlier build that loaded xcolor and
% hyperref: hyperref's four-argument \contentsline with \textcolor, which
% this build does not define. Its old entry is not in the page, and the
% stale file stays as it is.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newlistof{example}{exp}{Examples}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exp}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\listofexample
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\example{A new example}
\end{document}
